caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

The very first computer 'bug' was an actual moth! Yes, a real insect!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🐛 In 1947, engineers on the Harvard Mark II found a mysterious malfunction.
👩‍💻 Pioneering computer scientist Grace Hopper discovered the culprit: a moth trapped in a relay!
📜 She famously taped the insect into the logbook, declaring they were 'debugging' the system.

This tiny creature quite literally gave us the term for fixing all our tech glitches today!
